beats: I wanted a badge showing how many people are on my site right now — but some of my old numbers were already wrong.
Some days had been multiplied by up to ten times, turning a quiet Tuesday into a viral one.
A small Cloudflare worker now fetches the real count every minute, without ever exposing a secret key.
I also rebuilt every inflated day in the history for good.
Now the badge refreshes every sixty seconds, live and accurate.
